dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2017 by-election. Since 2014, voters can vote at any voting place within the City.

Prior to the 2014 municipal election, the city was divided into voting divisions and voters were required to vote at a designated voting place within their assigned voting division.

The City operates an at-large voting system.

Note:

UBC Lands and UEL residents are only eligible to vote for School Trustees.

Data currency

​​These are the voting places used for the City's 2017 municipal by-election during Advance Voting and on General Voting Day.
